scenarios.description: A user asks for today's weather.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: No required conflict; a short-lived candidate may coexist with background candidates.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Query candidate may temporarily dominate only for current relevance.
scenarios.carryover: No long-term carryover is inferred after the answer.
unknowns: whether weather is needed for a later plan
scenarios.resource_behavior: Use bounded current projection; do not expand long-term history without support.
forbidden_conclusions: the user has a stable weather interest
the query is a long-term Goal
scenarios.expected_handoff: Candidate-only handoff if causal clarification is needed; otherwise preserve the short-lived Intent trace without a causal claim.

scenarios.description: The user explicitly says they want to find their keys.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: May coexist with an avoid-delay or leave-home candidate.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Finding keys may temporarily dominate because it blocks another activity, but remains distinct from Decision.
scenarios.carryover: Can persist across rooms while the missing-object state remains unresolved.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Reduce search projection breadth if constrained while retaining all source and candidate records.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Intent candidate plus Context, PCN projection, unknown, and constraint refs for future causal/search reasoning.

scenarios.description: At home with family, an urgent unfinished work matter remains mentally active.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Work and family Intent candidates coexist and may conflict for attention and time.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Urgent work may temporarily dominate while family engagement remains preserved and suppressed.
scenarios.carryover: Work candidate carries from office-related Mental Field into the home Context.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Bound active projection without deleting either candidate.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Both Intent candidates, conflict and temporary-dominance refs, carryover provenance, and unknowns.

scenarios.description: Repeated overtime strengthens both unfinished-work continuity and concern about family participation.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Three candidates may coexist with unresolved resource conflict.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: No permanent winner; dominance can alternate by Context and resource state.
scenarios.carryover: Recurring candidates preserve history without becoming Identity traits.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Fatigue may narrow elaboration and amplify preservation constraints; it cannot select the winner.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Coexisting candidates with recurrence, resource, Role, Relationship, and uncertainty refs.

scenarios.description: The user leaves the office but unresolved work remains cognitively active at home.
potential_intents: move the unfinished work toward completion
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: May coexist with rest, family, or recovery candidates.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Can become suppressed at home and reactivate when project cues appear.
scenarios.carryover: Explicitly preserved across the physical Field transition; Mental Field Continuity is a separate Context reference.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Low evening resources can defer qualification or reduce projection breadth without termination.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Carryover candidate with source/target Context, unfinished-state, Memory, resource, and uncertainty refs.

scenarios.description: The same person is both spouse and colleague, activating distinct relationship and Role constraints.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Both candidates coexist; their preferred future states may partly conflict.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Current Field may temporarily amplify one Role-bound candidate without erasing the other.
scenarios.carryover: Either candidate may persist across a Role/Field switch if unresolved.
unknowns: which role is salient to the other person
whether the issue can be separated
scenarios.resource_behavior: Limit projection breadth under load but preserve both Relationship interpretations.
forbidden_conclusions: one person has one fixed Role
scenarios.expected_handoff: Two candidates with distinct Role and Relationship provenance plus coexistence/conflict annotations.

scenarios.description: Two people are divorced but remain colleagues, so historical and current relationships diverge.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Professional approach and personal avoidance may coexist.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Work Context may temporarily dominate outward projection while personal-boundary candidate remains active or suppressed.
scenarios.carryover: Historical relationship remains a reference, not the current Relationship truth or Self identity.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Historical breadth may shrink under limits, but the current/historical distinction must be retained.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Distinct current/historical Relationship refs, two Intent candidates, coexistence, and unknowns.

scenarios.description: Meeting someone from an old relationship reactivates dormant associations and possible direction candidates.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Approach and avoidance may conflict while observation coexists.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Self and current Context may suppress an old candidate without deleting it.
scenarios.carryover: Dormant historical candidate can reactivate but recurrence does not prove continuity or truth.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Under low capacity, preserve Unknown and use a narrow observation projection.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Alternative Intent candidates, dormant/reactivated state refs, historical provenance, and Unknown.

scenarios.description: Fear is present while crossing a road, alongside a safety-oriented tendency.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Safety candidate may conflict with urgency to reach the destination.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Safety may temporarily dominate under hard Self constraints; dominance still is not Decision.
scenarios.carryover: Fear influence may decay after leaving the road Field; unresolved safety direction need not become Identity.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Constrained resources prioritize preserving safety evidence and Unknown, not automatic action.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Safety/avoidance candidate plus Emotion influence, Field evidence, Self constraint, urgency conflict, and uncertainty refs.

scenarios.description: A person says 'I'm fine' while observed behavior appears abnormal.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Alternative potential candidates remain unresolved and may conflict with the explicit statement.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: No dominance is asserted from behavioral mismatch alone.
scenarios.carryover: Potential candidates may expire or remain pending only with preserved temporal support.
scenarios.resource_behavior: Low resources preserve the contradiction and Unknown rather than forcing classification.
scenarios.expected_handoff: Potential Intent alternatives and contradictory evidence only; no certain Intent or causal explanation.

scenarios.description: The long-term direction 'make Luna a real electronic life' remains relevant across many Context changes.
potential_intents: advance Luna toward sustained electronic-life capability
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Can coexist with current phase, safety, maintenance, and resource candidates.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: May become dormant during unrelated Contexts and reactivate during development without permanent dominance.
scenarios.carryover: Preserved across Context switches when provenance and continuity support remain available.
unknowns: future definition of sufficient electronic life
scenarios.resource_behavior: Only current active projection breadth is reduced; the long-term source trace is not deleted.
forbidden_conclusions: long-term Intent is Luna's immutable Identity
Intent directly creates a roadmap task
scenarios.expected_handoff: Persistent Intent candidate with continuity, Self constraint, phase Context, uncertainty, and alternative-path refs.

scenarios.description: A low-resource condition occurs while several Intent candidates are active or dormant.
scenarios.coexistence_or_conflict: Resource contention is represented without forcing semantic conflict or a final winner.
scenarios.suppression_or_dominance: Noncritical projections may be temporarily suppressed; safety-relevant projection may be amplified as a candidate constraint.
scenarios.carryover: Dormant and carried candidates retain provenance for future reactivation.
unknowns: which deferred evidence will later matter
scenarios.resource_behavior: Shrink active projection, alternative expansion, and historical retrieval breadth; never delete sources or change truth.
forbidden_conclusions: resource state selects the true Intent
resource hint is a Decision or model switch
scenarios.expected_handoff: Resource-constrained candidate set with explicit omissions, preserved Unknown, provenance, and no action authorization.
